source.note: Corrected Phase 12 manifest. The supplied source identifies Phase 12 as Prescription Management and explicitly states 1 Epic, 11 Features, 32 User Stories, 603 Tasks, and 647 Total Work Items.

phase.name: Prescription Management
phase.objective: Provide a controlled prescription workflow from creation through finalization and dispensing while preserving prescription history and preventing invalid dispensing.

work_item_ranges.tasks: 603 tasks as explicitly specified by the source

critical_business_rules: Prescription owns prescription data but not patient/customer identity.
Prescription references approved Medicine master records.
Sales owns the sale and dispensing transaction.
Finalized prescription history must not be destructively overwritten.
Medicine selection must be validated against Medicine master.
Dispensing must not exceed permitted prescription quantity where quantity limits apply.
Partial dispensing must be supported where the business workflow permits it.
Remaining quantity must be calculated consistently.
Prescription status must control downstream dispensing eligibility.
Cancelled, expired or otherwise ineligible prescriptions must not be accepted where prohibited.
Invalid patient/prescriber relationships must be rejected before finalization.
Sensitive prescription information must be permission protected.
Prescription mutations must be auditable where required.
Offline mutations must be persisted locally before synchronization.
Synchronization must be idempotent and conflict-safe.

patient: Search/select patient from approved Party/Customer model
sales_dispensing: Allow Sales to identify applicable prescription
Link prescription to dispensing transaction where supported

rules: Prescription mutations must be persisted locally before synchronization.
Prescription and PrescriptionItem changes must synchronize consistently.
UUID/idempotency mechanisms must prevent duplicate records during retries.
Finalized prescription history must not be overwritten by stale synchronization data.
Synchronization conflicts must be explicit and resolvable.

security_and_compliance: Backend/domain service is authoritative for business rules.
Sensitive prescription information must not be unnecessarily exposed in list screens.
Direct record access must validate authorization.
Historical records must be protected from unsafe destructive changes.
Important prescription operations must be audited.
Duplicate/retry behavior must be deterministic where synchronization is involved.
ui_standards: Prescription entry optimized for fast pharmacy workflow.
Searchable patient and prescriber master-data lookup.
Medicine selection through Medicine master search.
Validation errors close to the relevant field/item.
Status actions shown only when permitted.
Prescription history filtered by patient, prescriber, date and status.
Dispensing UI clearly shows prescribed, dispensed and remaining quantities.
Sensitive information minimized in list screens.
testing_matrix: Patient association and invalid patient scenarios
Prescriber association and invalid prescriber scenarios
Lifecycle valid/invalid transitions, cancellation and archive
definition_of_done: Prescription and PrescriptionItem are implemented according to finalized schema decisions.
Prescription references valid patient/customer and prescriber records.
Prescription items reference valid Medicine records.
Dosage, frequency, duration and quantity rules are enforced.
Prescription lifecycle transitions are explicitly validated.
Sales can identify and validate applicable prescriptions.
Partial dispensing is correctly supported where required.
Sensitive prescription information is permission protected.
Outbox synchronization is retry-safe and idempotent.
Conflict handling is documented and tested.
Angular workflows are keyboard-first and efficient.
SQLite and PostgreSQL compatibility is verified.
Performance is measured for common search and validation paths.

upstream: Phase 4 — User, Role, Permission & Security Management

database_overview.note: The approved database overview identifies Prescription management and these two core tables. No unsupported prescription tables are introduced as approved schema.

source_alignment.schema_policy: Where field-level definitions are not approved, the backlog uses schema-finalization work rather than inventing database columns.
